messages:
incident_bot: 🚨 Alert: spike in TLS handshake failures for api-gateway-prod (rule: tls.handshake_rate > 5% over 5m). Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd123

incident_bot: summary: handshake_error_count = 12% of ingress requests (5m window). Increased 40x vs baseline. Affected: api-gateway-prod frontends (c6g-*), most traffic EU-WEST and NA.
devon_oncall: i'm on call, looking now. paging infra and platform. @jordan_platform can you pull LB cert state? i'll check gateway pods + logs.

devon_oncall: quick check: lb logs show repeated "tls: handshake failure" and backend logs show `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority` in some client traces.

jordan_platform: checking certs on s3/buckets used by cert-rotator... listing bucket now.

jordan_platform: found latest rotation job ran ~1758120000 and uploaded a new leaf cert at s3://certs/prod/api-gw/2026-03-14/leaf.pem but intermediate.pem is missing from that upload. older object 2026-03-01 has full chain. suspect rotation job failed to bundle chain.

devon_oncall: that would explain clients that require full chain (some mTLS clients) failing, while others that cache intermediate succeed. can you confirm LB is serving only leaf (no intermediate)?

jordan_platform: yes, checking LB config: GET /configs/api-gw -> attached cert = leaf only. attaching small snippet:

```
# lb cert chain (fingerprint)
leaf: SHA256=aa:bb:cc
intermediate: MISSING
root: present on client CA store
```

lucy_support: customers reporting 502/gateway errors and some sessions failing to establish. support-ticket count doubled in last 15m. top impacted tenant: acme-inc (EU).

devon_oncall: OK mitigation plan: 1) re-upload full chain (intermediate + leaf) to LB, 2) if LB can't hot-reload, fallback to previous working cert bundle, 3) restart api-gateway pods if needed. I'll attempt re-upload of known-good bundle from 2026-03-01.

devon_oncall: running aws s3 cp s3://certs/prod/api-gw/2026-03-01/full-chain.pem /tmp/full-chain.pem && kubectl set secret tls api-gw-tls -n infra --key /tmp/priv.key --cert /tmp/full-chain.pem

```
# commands
aws s3 cp s3://certs/prod/api-gw/2026-03-01/full-chain.pem /tmp/full-chain.pem
kubectl -n infra delete secret api-gw-tls || true
kubectl -n infra create secret tls api-gw-tls --key /tmp/priv.key --cert /tmp/full-chain.pem
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/api-gateway
```

devon_oncall: started applying. will post progress.

sre_bot: deploybot: rollout of deployment/api-gateway started (revision: v2026-03-14-1224). watching pods.

maria_ops: copying relevant customer impact blurb for comms: "We observed TLS handshake failures causing 5xx/gateway errors for a subset of customer traffic; mitigation in progress." i'll prep status page if we have confirmed mitigation.

devon_oncall: after re-creating secret and restarting pods, running quick check from a failing region:

```
# before mitigation (curl output)
$ curl -vk https://api.redwood.example -o /dev/null
* TLS handshake has read 0 and written 299
* SSL: no alternative certificate subject name matches target host name
* Closing connection 0
curl: (35) SSL: no alternative certificate subject name matches target host name

# after mitigation (openssl verify)
$ openssl s_client -connect api.redwood.example:443 -servername api.redwood.example -showcerts
...verify return:1
---
```

jordan_platform: LB config shows new secret with full chain attached and in-use. cert fingerprint matches 2026-03-01 bundle.

devon_oncall: metrics update: handshake failure rate dropped from 12% -> 0.25% over 6m post-rollout. Latency stable. Rolling window still watching for residual errors.

lucy_support: tickets: top 10 impacted tenants notified via priority channel with short blurb + ETA. asking for postmortem once stable.

maria_ops: taking handoff for follow-up (postmortem, RCA, customer comms). devon, can you summarize root cause and actions taken? i will own the incident doc + status page update.

devon_oncall: root cause: automated cert-rotator job uploaded new leaf cert but failed to include intermediate chain due to S3 upload step skipping combined bundle when rotation job hit a transient timeout; LB accepted leaf only. impact: partial TLS handshake failures for clients requiring full chain (~12% of requests at peak). mitigation: restored previous working full-chain bundle from object 2026-03-01, rotated secret, restarted gateway pods. verification: openssl s_client and Grafana show errors back to baseline. next steps: patch rotator to validate bundle presence post-upload, add pre-deploy check that LB has full chain, add integration test that simulates TLS chain missing.

maria_ops: thanks. moving incident to "mitigated" and will create postmortem ticket INC-2026-045. ETA for postmortem draft: 2026-03-15 20:00 UTC. will include customer outreach copy.

devon_oncall: passing oncall to next person. all good from infra side. marking pager resolved. :white_check_mark:

sre_bot: incident_bot: incident status changed to MITIGATED by maria_ops at 1758124056.

lucy_support: posting status page update now. cc: @jordan_platform for follow-up on rotator logs.

jordan_platform: will add extra validation step to rotation job and open PR for config change.

maria_ops: thanks everyone. closing thread but keeping follow-ups in #postmortems.
